import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p=params
    return p[0]+p[1]*T+p[2]*T**2+(p[3]+p[4]*T)*eps**p[5]+(p[6]+p[7]*T)*(1-np.exp(-p[8]*eps))+p[9]*eps*T**2
